### 6.230 Polygon trade-tape microstructure and equity-data expansion

This section tests genuinely new tape information rather than another transformation of five-minute OHLCV.
Before bulk fetching or performance, a bounded 2021 entitlement probe covered fifteen equity endpoints.
Historical trades, one-second aggregates, news, quarterly financials, dividends, splits, short interest,
short volume, EDGAR index, trade-condition mappings, and exchange mappings were accessible. Historical NBBO
quotes and Benzinga earnings/guidance returned HTTP 403. Consequently, this research can measure trade-tape
structure but cannot claim spread, quoted depth, true quote imbalance, or auction order imbalance. Polygon
condition codes identifying official/opening prints are used only as an opening-participation proxy.

The repository already contained approximately 13.5 GB of event-screened tick trades and broad five-minute
aggregates, plus 2018-2024 news and quarterly financials. Those were not downloaded again. A resumable bulk
fetch added all records returned in 420 monthly chunks from 2018-01-01 through 2024-12-31 for five new
context datasets:

| dataset | rows | observed range | raw duplicate audit |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| dividends | 281,471 | 2018-01-02 to 2024-12-31 | 0 |
| splits | 7,569 | 2018-01-02 to 2024-12-31 | 0 |
| short interest | 840,000 | 2018-01-12 to 2024-12-31 | 0 |
| short volume | 1,140,000 | 2024-02-06 to 2024-12-31 | 0 |
| EDGAR index | 7,657,184 | 2018-01-02 to 2024-12-31 | 15,936 exact rows |

All 9,926,224 rows remain raw and bounded at 2024-12-31. Short volume cannot support 2018-2021 development
because Polygon returns no earlier observations. EDGAR accession numbers legitimately map to multiple
filer/ticker rows, and the raw endpoint also contains 15,936 exact duplicates; downstream users must
`drop_duplicates` without deleting or rewriting the raw cache. Short interest requires an explicit
publication lag before predictive use, and the newly fetched context data was not used to select this
trade-tape family. Fetching context through 2024 did not open or score validation performance.

Trade-tape data and leakage contract:

- The pre-existing causal fetch plan contains 28,225 ticker-days and 706 tickers from the quarterly PIT
  market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility, ADV20 >= `$10m`, price >= `$5`, and absolute gap
  <=30%. Precandidates are prior-day return <=-5% or opening gap >=+2%. Old/manual 62 membership is unused.
- All signal features use raw Polygon trades with SIP timestamps in `[09:30,10:00)` ET. Entry is the exact
  10:05 five-minute open, providing a five-minute execution gap. Exit is the exact 15:55 close with only a
  post-selection 16:00-open fallback. No selected trade in this family required the fallback.
- New fields include exchange-dollar HHI, number of exchanges, lit/TRF dollar split, fixed-`$100k` trade
  flow, block and odd-lot shares, odd-lot signed flow, intermarket-sweep and cross shares, condition-coded
  opening-print share/VWAP, SIP latency, interarrival times, and per-second burstiness. The fixed large-trade
  definition and five candidate rules were frozen before PnL.
- Exactly five rows were pre-registered: YDAY large-lit sponsorship, YDAY broad-venue confirmation, YDAY
  opening-print absorption, gap-up large-lit sponsorship, and gap-up sweep confirmation. The common price
  confirmation is positive 09:30-to-10:00 return, at least 100 signal trades, and at least `$1m` signal
  dollars.
- Selection fully rebuilds up to three longs each day after exact-entry filtering, with one ticker per SIC,
  20% current-NAV weight per name, 0.6x maximum entry gross, 1% ADV cap, compounding, and 4/8-bps costs per
  traded dollar per side. Development is 2018-03-29 through 2021-12-31. Calendar 2022 was locked until a
  development passer existed.

Only YDAY broad-venue confirmation passed every frozen development gate. Its yearly base-cost PnL was

strong but materially dependent on 2020. Under the frozen selection policy, it alone opened 2022 validation;
the other four rules remained closed.

The independent 2022 result fails decisively: 114 active days, 218 legs, gross PnL `-$11.377k`, net PnL
`-$14.655k`, CAGR -14.81%, Sharpe -1.017, dollar DD `-$16.191k`, percentage DD -15.97%, stress PnL
`-$17.586k`, and gross edge -9.92 bps per active day. Top10 positive-PnL share also rises from 27.86% in
development to 51.55% in validation. This is economic sign reversal before costs, not a marginal gate miss.

Development concentration for the selected rule is acceptable: 272 tickers, effective positive ticker
count 64.96, and top1/top3/top5/top10 positive-PnL shares of 5.11%/11.05%/16.55%/27.86%. Validation trades
123 tickers with effective count 27.42 and corresponding shares of 8.55%/20.14%/31.05%/51.55%. Maximum order
participation is 0.1457% ADV in development and 0.0477% in validation. Dollar and percentage DD are both
reported from the compounded equity series.

Rule selection and trade selection remain separate. Rule selection compares exactly five frozen development
rows; one pass selects a single validation rule with no validation re-selection. Trade selection rebuilds
the full eligible candidate set each day, then applies the frozen tape filter, rank, exact-entry availability,
SIC cap, full refill, current NAV, and ADV sizing. No ticker-removal PnL subtraction or old-62 learning is
used. The independent strategy audit passes 33 checks and reconciles daily, ending-equity, and ticker PnL
within `1e-6`. The first replay invocation stopped before selection/PnL because a tape column duplicated an
existing flow-cache column; the preregistration records the narrow merge correction made before the first
performance output.

### 6.231 Systematic PIT feature-horizon map: temporal replication failure

The volume of newly available data does not by itself establish independent predictive information. To
separate stable effects from attractive anecdotes, this pass froze a univariate feature-horizon map before
performance: 144 trade-tape cells, nine short-interest cells, nine news-intensity cells, and eighteen EDGAR
filing cells, for 180 simultaneous tests. Discovery is 2018-03-29 through 2020-12-31, calendar 2021 is a
separate temporal replication period, and calendar 2022 is a conditional confirmation period that remains
closed unless at least one cell passes both earlier stages. No 2022 performance was scored, and no 2023-2026
performance was read or used by this map.

Data and leakage contract:

- All observations are intersected with the daily survivorship/PIT eligible panel. The old/manual 62 does
  not enter feature construction, membership, ranking, or selection.
- Tape features use only Polygon SIP trades before 10:00 ET and the pre-registered PIT top500/event-screened
  sample. Tape outcomes begin at the exact 10:05 open and cover intraday, overnight, five-session, and
  twenty-session horizons. The tape branch is therefore causal but is not a full broad-universe tape census.
- News published before 09:25 ET may enter that session; later articles enter the next market session.
  Short-interest observations become available only on the tenth market session strictly after settlement.
  EDGAR rows are exact-deduplicated and always enter on the next session because the source has date-only
  filing time. Event outcomes use the 09:35 open and 15:55 closes at one, five, and twenty sessions.
- Continuous cells compare same-date top and bottom quintiles. EDGAR binary cells compare the indicated
  filing category with other filing-event names on the same date. Each result is the mean daily cohort
  spread, not a compounded tradable portfolio.
- Benjamini-Hochberg correction is applied jointly across all 180 discovery tests at q <= 0.10. Frozen
  economic minima are 10 bps for intraday/overnight, 15 bps for one day, 40 bps for five days, and 80 bps
  for twenty days, with minimum date and observation breadth. Replication additionally requires the same
  sign, directional t >= 1.0, and at least 25% of discovery magnitude.

Four cells pass every discovery gate; none passes 2021 replication:

| context / feature / horizon | discovery spread / t / q | 2021 spread / t | result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| tape gap / exchange-dollar HHI / d20 | +2.507% / 5.03 / 0.000029 | -0.612% / -0.61 | sign reversal |
| tape gap / TRF-dollar share / d20 | +2.026% / 4.14 / 0.001571 | -1.833% / -1.87 | sign reversal |
| tape gap / p90 SIP latency / d20 | +1.653% / 3.10 / 0.058125 | -2.698% / -3.24 | sign reversal |
| EDGAR offering / d20 | -0.803% / -6.16 / 0.00000007 | +1.019% / 3.43 | sign reversal |

The post-selection yearly table below is attribution only and was not allowed to select or modify a cell:

| cell | 2018 partial | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 replication |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| tape gap / exchange-dollar HHI / d20 | +2.297% | +1.225% | +3.462% | -0.612% |
| tape gap / TRF-dollar share / d20 | +1.583% | +1.430% | +2.660% | -1.833% |
| tape gap / p90 SIP latency / d20 | +1.794% | +0.286% | +2.473% | -2.698% |
| EDGAR offering / d20 | -0.781% | -0.385% | -1.237% | +1.019% |

The strongest other EDGAR cells are also not candidates. Form 4/d20 has q approximately `2.6e-9` but its
+0.598% discovery spread misses the frozen 0.80% economic floor and reverses to -0.263% in 2021. 8-K/d20
has q approximately 0.004 but only -0.364%, below the same floor. The best short-interest q is 0.564 and the
best YDAY-tape q is 0.200. News needs a separate, newly pre-registered event-versus-no-news design: within the
current news-only sample, article count and publisher count are too tied within most dates to form both
quintiles, so all nine news cells are non-finite rather than evidence of zero news edge. Short volume is
excluded because Polygon history begins only in February 2024.

Rule selection and trade selection are intentionally distinct. Rule selection is the frozen 180-cell
multiple-testing and replication procedure; it selects zero cells. There is consequently no portfolio
trade-selection stage, re-selection, full-refill book, or replacement effect to measure. CAGR, dollar and
percentage DD, ticker PnL shares, and effective ticker count are not meaningful for cohort spreads and are
therefore not reported. Their absence is a reason this work cannot be a production PASS, not an invitation
to infer favorable risk statistics. A future executable book would have to rebuild PIT ranking and refill,
compound sizing, costs, missing-price outcomes, and all concentration/DD metrics from scratch.

The independent audit re-computes BH q-values and both gates, verifies all 180 unique cells, confirms four
discovery passes and zero replication passes, verifies the empty confirmation artifact, and hashes the full
daily PIT, market-cap, eligibility, tape, context, and event dependencies. It passes all 16 checks. A separate
720-row yearly diagnostic covers every cell for 2018-2021 and is explicitly marked as not a selection input.

### 6.232 Multivariate interactions with nested temporal gates

This section executes the next pre-registered family proposed by section 6.231. It tests whether fixed
linear or shallow nonlinear combinations recover information that was absent from the univariate map. The
family contains exactly eight rows: ridge and shallow histogram gradient boosting for tape-gap/d20,
tape-YDAY/d20, broad-event/d5, and broad-event/d20. No hyperparameter search is performed. The gradient
booster is frozen at learning rate 0.05, 100 iterations, seven leaves, minimum leaf size 200, L2 of 10, and
fixed seed; ridge alpha is 100.

Data, sample, and leakage contract:

- Training begins in 2018 partial. Development performance is genuinely out-of-fold: train 2018 and score
  2019, then train 2018-2019 and score 2020. Any training row whose target crosses the next scored year is
  purged. Calendar 2021 is a locked replication stage opened only by a development passer. Calendar 2022 is
  a second conditional stage opened only by a 2021 passer. No development row passed, so neither 2021 nor
  2022 performance was scored; no 2023-2026 performance was scored or used.
- The universe is quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT price/liquidity eligibility.
  Tape contexts additionally apply the previously frozen YDAY or gap precandidate definition. The old/manual
  62 is absent from membership, features, training, and scoring.
- Tape models use eighteen pre-10:00 trade-structure fields plus causal price, volatility, PIT market cap,
  ADV, signal return, trade count, and signal dollars. Entry is the exact 10:05 open. Broad models use PIT
  price/momentum/volatility/sector residuals/liquidity, news available by 09:25 ET or deferred to the next
  session, next-session EDGAR flags, and the latest short-interest observation after a ten-session lag.
  Broad entry is the 09:35 open. Continuous inputs are same-date percentile ranks; filing and availability
  fields are binary.
- Broad-event rows explicitly contain no-news and no-filing controls, correcting the degenerate news-only
  comparison in section 6.231. Training returns are winsorized only within the training fold and each date
  receives equal aggregate model weight. No validation label enters fitting or preprocessing.
- Scores rebuild same-date top and bottom quintiles before observing outcomes. The statistic is the daily
  top-minus-bottom underlying return. A frozen 16-bps round-trip spread cost proxy subtracts 4 bps per side
  at entry and exit for both legs. Missing exact exits use the last available close after entry and no later
  than target; no remaining tape write-offs and at most seven broad-row write-offs occur.
- Benjamini-Hochberg correction covers all eight development rows. Gates require q <=0.10, net t >=2,
  positive net spread in both 2019 and 2020, sufficient breadth, and net edge >=0.40% for d5 or >=0.80% for
  d20. Replication and confirmation rules were frozen before performance.

Development OOF results are:

| candidate | gross spread | net spread | net t | q | dates / observations per side | result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| tape gap ridge d20 | +0.930% | +0.770% | 1.32 | 0.899 | 441 / 2,466 | fail |
| tape gap HGB d20 | +0.574% | +0.414% | 0.69 | 0.899 | 441 / 2,466 | fail |
| tape YDAY ridge d20 | +0.041% | -0.119% | -0.17 | 0.899 | 321 / 752 | fail |
| tape YDAY HGB d20 | +0.247% | +0.087% | 0.13 | 0.899 | 321 / 752 | fail |
| broad event ridge d5 | +0.110% | -0.050% | -0.30 | 0.899 | 490 / 48,496 | fail |
| broad event HGB d5 | +0.007% | -0.153% | -0.99 | 0.899 | 490 / 48,496 | fail |
| broad event ridge d20 | +0.269% | +0.109% | 0.49 | 0.899 | 460 / 45,502 | fail |
| broad event HGB d20 | +0.251% | +0.091% | 0.49 | 0.899 | 460 / 45,502 | fail |

The pooled tape-gap ridge row comes closest economically but misses the frozen d20 net floor, t gate, and
multiple-testing gate. More importantly, yearly attribution exposes a common regime split:

| candidate | 2019 net spread / t | 2020 net spread / t |
|---|---:|---:|
| tape gap ridge d20 | -1.387% / -1.71 | +2.858% / 3.52 |
| tape gap HGB d20 | -1.271% / -1.46 | +2.046% / 2.54 |
| tape YDAY ridge d20 | +0.562% / 0.64 | -0.666% / -0.65 |

| broad event HGB d20 | -0.595% / -3.18 | +0.776% / 2.45 |

The apparent pooled tape and broad d20 effects are therefore predominantly 2020 effects, not stable OOF
relationships. Shallow nonlinear interactions do not fix the sign instability and generally underperform
their ridge baselines. Broad event/no-event information has substantial breadth but no economically useful
net spread under this design.

Rule selection and trade selection remain separate. Rule selection compares the eight frozen model/context/
horizon rows after OOF scoring and selects zero. Trade selection independently rebuilds each date's ranked
quintiles; no ticker is removed using realized PnL and no cohort is refilled from future availability. Since
no rule reaches replication, there is no executable compounding book. CAGR, dollar/percentage DD,
top1/top3/top5/top10 ticker PnL shares, and effective ticker count are consequently undefined rather than
favorable. A production claim is explicitly prohibited by the preregistration.

The first invocation computed development rows in memory but stopped before writing or printing a performance
table because the zero-pass branch did not create empty `rep_*` columns. The preregistration records the
narrow plumbing correction made before rerun; candidates, features, models, labels, splits, costs, and gates
did not change. The independent audit re-computes aggregate and yearly spreads, t statistics, p/q values,
all development gates, matched cohort counts, the 16-bps cost difference, date boundaries, and the empty
confirmation artifact. It passes 18 checks.

### 6.233 Complete 8-K text semantic events: buyback discovery fails temporal replication

This pass adds genuinely new filing content rather than another transformation of the prior SEC metadata.
Before fetching or reading filing text, it froze six phrase-based event classes from complete 8-K
submissions: buyback authorization, workforce reduction, going-concern distress, financial restatement,
cyber incident, and strategic alternatives. It deliberately does not retest Item 2.02, deal/governance,
13D, Form 4 transaction, or ownership-role definitions already covered by earlier families.

Data, sample, and leakage contract:

- Polygon's SEC index supplies the accession and complete-submission URL; raw complete submissions come
  from SEC Archives and are retained gzip-compressed. Discovery contains 18,892 unique 8-K accessions from
  2018-2020 PIT-top500 membership: 18,827 fetched and 65 explicit failures (64 responses above the frozen
  30 MiB cap and one SEC 404). The gated 2021 replication contains 6,006 accessions: 5,985 fetched and 21
  explicit oversize failures. There are no unresolved accessions in either stage.
- The universe is backward-assigned quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with the daily PIT price and
  liquidity filter (price >= $5 and ADV20 >= $10m). The old/manual 62 is not used in membership, labels,
  rule selection, or event selection.
- A filing is usable only when its SEC submission header supplies an acceptance timestamp. It enters the
  first full session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly later than acceptance; entry is exact 09:35. No
  filing date is substituted for a missing timestamp.
- Fixed regexes are applied to the complete submission text. They require the frozen phrase/window rules
  for repurchase authorization, workforce reduction, going concern, non-reliance/restatement, cyber breach,
  or strategic-alternatives language. No phrase, proximity window, or class was selected after returns.
- Outcomes are 09:35 to 15:55 after one, five, or twenty sessions. Event return is residualized against the
  same-session same-SIC median among eligible PIT-top500 names, falling back to the PIT-top500 median when
  fewer than five SIC controls exist. An exact exit is preferred; otherwise the last price after entry and
  no later than target is used, with a frozen -100% underlying write-off if none exists.
- Discovery tests all 6 x 3 = 18 class/horizon cells jointly with Benjamini-Hochberg at q <= 0.10. Coverage
  requires at least 80 events, at least 15 in each discovery year, and at least two annual means agreeing
  with the aggregate sign. Statistical/economic gates require absolute t >= 2 and absolute mean residual
  >= 0.15% for d1, 0.40% for d5, or 0.80% for d20. Replication requires at least 20 events, the same sign,
  directional t >= 1, and at least 25% of discovery magnitude.
- Discovery is 2018-2020 and temporal replication is calendar 2021. No 2022-2026 filing content or
  performance was consumed by this family.

Eight cells pass coverage and exactly one passes all discovery gates:

| event / horizon | events | residual mean | t | q | agreeing years | discovery result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| buyback authorization / d1 | 478 | +0.3123% | 3.05 | 0.0417 | 3/3 | pass |
| buyback authorization / d5 | 478 | +0.0588% | 0.32 | 0.965 | 2/3 | fail |
| buyback authorization / d20 | 478 | +0.1784% | 0.62 | 0.965 | 3/3 | fail |

The selected d1 cell's post-selection yearly attribution is:

| year | events | residual mean | t |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2018 | 189 | +0.3161% | 2.07 |
| 2019 | 159 | +0.4056% | 2.56 |
| 2020 | 130 | +0.1927% | 0.82 |

Only `buyback_authorization/d1` was frozen for 2021 replication. It maps 176 events and remains positive,
but falls to +0.0555% with t = 0.36. The frozen minimum magnitude was +0.0781%, and directional t had to
reach 1.0. The effect therefore loses more than 80% of its discovery magnitude and fails both replication
gates. This is temporal failure, not a missing-price artifact: d1 has zero exit fallbacks and zero write-offs
in both discovery and replication. Discovery d5/d20 have two/four fallbacks and zero write-offs.

Rule selection and trade selection are separate. Rule selection is the frozen, multiplicity-corrected
18-cell family and selects one discovery rule but zero replicated rules. Trade selection then includes every
causally available qualifying filing for the frozen cell; it performs no ticker-PnL removal, reaction filter,
direction inversion, or post-outcome refill. Since the only rule fails before portfolio replay, there is no
executable compounding book. CAGR, dollar and percentage DD, top1/top3/top5/top10 ticker PnL shares, and
effective ticker count are undefined, not zero. Their absence itself prohibits a production PASS.

Fetch execution remained within the frozen accession set and research rules. The preregistration records
only operational corrections made before labels or performance existed: resumable fetch-only/classify-only
modes, explicit oversize/error accounting, and year-part process scheduling for the hash-locked classifier.
Regexes, accessions, outcomes, splits, gates, and multiple-testing rules did not change. The independent
audit recomputes selection and replication, verifies coverage, hashes, and closed later data, and passes all
24 checks.

### 6.234 Monthly-retrained opening policy with causal abstention

The failure of fixed rules does not imply that a trading process must keep the same direction and activity
through every regime. This family therefore freezes the learning procedure rather than a directional setup:
one model is retrained monthly using only prior data, an inner temporal block calibrates predicted edge and
may disable the next month, and each eligible day can choose long, short, 0.5x, 1.0x, or no trade. This is
different from the fixed opening rules in sections 6.222-6.225, the source-level allocator in section 6.216,
and the annual d5/d20 model rows in section 6.232.

Pre-registered data and leakage contract:

- Source rows are the 32,176 broad opening-event ticker-days already formed causally for section 6.222:
  quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with current daily PIT eligibility, price >= $5, and lagged
  ADV20 >= $10m. The old/manual 62 is absent from event formation, features, training, and selection.
- Features available by 09:35 include lagged stock/SPY return, volatility, beta, market cap and ADV; current
  gap, first-five return/range/close location/rvol, market and SIC opening residuals; and total, early, late,
  large, TRF, and lit tick-flow fields based only on SIP arrivals strictly before 09:35. Continuous fields
  become same-date cross-sectional percentile ranks in [-1,1].
- The sole model is a fixed shallow `HistGradientBoostingRegressor`: learning rate 0.05, 100 iterations,
  seven leaves, minimum leaf 100, L2 10, and seed 314159. The target is exact 09:40 open to exact 15:55 open
  return. Training-only targets are clipped at 1/99 percentiles and each training date receives equal weight.
- On the first session of each month, the model uses at most the prior 378 sessions. A provisional model
  trains before a 63-session inner calibration block; at least 189 core sessions and 20 valid calibration
  books are required. The realized-on-predicted calibration slope is clipped to [0,1]. The coming month is
  disabled unless calibration net return after the 8-bps base round trip is positive overall and separately
  in both chronological halves. The final model then refits on the complete prior window.
- Every day independently rebuilds three predicted longs and three predicted shorts, maximum one ticker per
  SIC per side. Entry admission and fill use the exact 09:40 open after the signal. Future exit availability
  never changes ranks or refill. Calibrated whole-book edge below 12 bps means no trade, 12-20 bps uses 0.5x
  gross, and at least 20 bps uses 1.0x. Base/stress costs are 4/8 bps per traded dollar per side, with 1%
  annual intraday short borrow and no financing.
- Development is monthly walk-forward from 2019-06-03 through 2021-12-31. Calendar 2022 was locked behind
  the complete development gate. The policy fails development, so no 2022 performance is scored and no
  2023-2026 input or performance is consumed.

The one frozen adaptive policy produces:

| scope | active days / legs | gross edge per active day | gross / net PnL | CAGR / Sharpe | DD $ / % | stress PnL | gate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 2019-2021 development | 49 / 294 | -8.06 bps | `-$3.850k` / `-$5.991k` | -2.37% / -1.14 | `-$6.596k` / -6.56% | `-$7.966k` | fail |

Yearly attribution separates weak execution economics from model failure:

| year | active days | gross PnL | trading cost | borrow | net PnL |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2019 partial | 0 | `$0.000k` | `$0.000k` | `$0.000k` | `$0.000k` |
| 2020 | 30 | `$0.031k` | `$1.194k` | `$0.028k` | `-$1.191k` |
| 2021 | 19 | `-$3.881k` | `$0.897k` | `$0.021k` | `-$4.800k` |

The policy is selective but not successfully adaptive. Of 31 monthly vintages, only five pass the frozen
calibration-health rule; one of those finds no day above the edge threshold, leaving four traded months.
Calibration permits June/October/November 2020 and August 2021, but their next-month gross results do not
persist. In particular, 2020 gross is approximately flat before cost and 2021 is already materially negative
before cost. This rejects the claim that the prior fixed-rule losses merely came from trading through the
wrong regimes. The model's own causal regime filter selects sparse periods that still reverse out of sample.

Risk and replay diagnostics do not explain the loss. The book trades 207 tickers; effective positive-PnL
ticker count is 44.60 and top1/top3/top5/top10 positive-PnL shares are
5.27%/14.52%/21.76%/37.90%. Exact EOD replay has zero fallback exits, maximum order participation is 0.141%
of ADV20, and dollar and percentage DD are both reported above. Daily compounding PnL, ending equity, and
ticker contribution reconcile within `3.3e-11`.

Rule selection and trade selection are distinct. Rule selection contains exactly one frozen learning
procedure: there is no post-result choice among model families, horizons, directions, or thresholds. Trade
selection is rebuilt by every model vintage from causal candidate admission, current scores, exact 09:40
entry, SIC-limited full refill, abstention, scale, costs, exit, and account equity. No ticker is removed by
realized PnL. The development gate fails breadth, return, Sharpe, positive-year, gross-edge, and stress-PnL
requirements; it passes DD and concentration requirements. Validation cannot replace or tune the rule.

The independent audit verifies script/input hashes, training cutoff before every model month, active-vintage
membership, exact 3-by-3 balance, SIC caps, scale thresholds, equal weights, exact entry and causal exit,
ADV, compounding, yearly/ticker reconciliation, concentration, all development gates, and the closed 2022
stage. It passes all 45 checks.

Verdict: **KILL THIS EXACT MONTHLY HGB ABSTENTION POLICY / DEVELOPMENT FAIL / 2022 REMAINS CLOSED / NO
PRODUCTION PASS.** This is stronger evidence than another fixed-rule failure: under this representation,
the causal calibration rule does not identify months in which model rankings transfer. It does not prove
that all adaptive day trading is impossible, but tuning this model, lookback, health test, or edge thresholds
on the observed result would be adaptive overfit rather than a clean follow-up.
